about_the_game:
After days of being held captive, you finally manage to escape from your kidnapper. However, the feeling of freedom you should feel evaporates when you realize you have the cell phone of the man who kidnapped you. The right thing to do would be to just wait for the police, but a strange feeling takes over you. There are dark secrets hidden in this cell phone, and YOU NEED TO UNCOVER THESE SECRETS!

A paranormal story is an investigation and suspense game where you must try to understand the past and secrets of the cell phone owner, through old messages, notes and mysterious apps through a fake smartphone interface.

Solve puzzles. Make choices. Uncover the truth.

During the game, you will have to solve countless puzzles. With each enigma unraveled, a new door opens — and with it, you move closer to the truth. But be careful: to reach it, you will have to make important decisions. Your choices will determine the fate of everyone.

Grab your notebook and start investigating

You will come across several symbols throughout your journey, and you will need to write them down if you want to solve them. However, if you choose not to decipher them, you will still be able to finish the game, but some parts of the story may go unnoticed.

Features

  • Explore a dark and fascinating world, seen through both a mobile interface and an unique hand-drawn animation.

  • Enjoy an engaging gameplay experience focused on solving puzzles to unlock phone access, decipher the meaning of symbols, connecting story points, and making choices that can affect your story.

  • A short narrative designed to keep the player immersed in the game’s universe even after its conclusion.

content_descriptors.notes: Extreme violence, blood and mutilation in hand-drawn characters.
